title: Changelog swipe-stripline annotated screenshot set
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: produce a lightweight, modular image pack for the upcoming March changelog and blog post that demonstrates feature callouts and compact before/after UI comparisons optimized for web and social. Deliver a single tidy set of 8 exported images plus source frames in Figma so marketing and docs can assemble variations without developer support.

Deliverables:
- 4 'stripline' before/after panels (desktop + mobile crops) that show the UI change at a glance. Each panel has a numbered callout and 1-line caption baked in. Filenames: swipe_strip_desktop_01_before_after.png, swipe_strip_mobile_01_before_after.png, etc.
- 2 compact 'feature callout' cards that highlight a single control or metric with an overlay annotation (arrow + short explainer). Filenames: callout_compact_latency.png, callout_compact_routing.png.
- 2 hero thumbnails sized for blog/social (1200x628 and 800x800) composed from the stripline assets. Filenames: hero_changelog_1200x628.png, hero_changelog_800x800.png.
- Figma source file with named frames and an export-ready component library (tokens, text styles, grid). Link: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/Changelog-Swipe-Stripline (internal).

Design decisions / trade-offs:
- Chose a tight 48px gutter and 12px corner radius to keep assets legible at social sizes. This sacrifices some whitespace compared to hero treatments but improves clarity in thumbnail crops.
- Used semi-opaque dark overlay for text on light UI screenshots to avoid re-screenshots; preserves authenticity of product visuals while keeping contrast standards.
- Opted to bake minimal explanatory copy into images so non-technical audiences can understand changes without alt text; longer release notes remain in the post.

Export specs and accessibility:
- Primary exports: PNG (lossless) for screenshots, SVG for simple callout overlays.
- Sizes: desktop stripline 1400x360, mobile stripline 640x360, hero 1200x628, square 800x800.
- Alt-text suggestions included in docs (see artifacts). Ensure all uploaded images to docs have those alt texts.

PRs / links:
- Design source: Figma frames exported to Google Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/EXAMPLE-Changelog-Swipe (internal).
- Implementation PR (placeholder for reference): https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2345

Open issues to resolve before final sign-off:
1) Confirm final copy for the four embedded captions (PM to provide final strings by 2026-03-14).
2) Decide whether to include a lightweight motion GIF for the stripline for the web article (engineering capacity required for optimized GIF or MP4).
3) Accessibility review: ensure color overlay contrast meets AA for 16pt body text; pending accessibility checklist from S&C.

Acceptance criteria:
- All 8 exports exist in Drive folder with approved filenames and sizes.
- Figma file contains component variants and documented export tokens.
- PM sign-off via comment on this ticket and PR merge of docs assets.
